parameters.content:
### 1. Configure and read
Set your ICP and score threshold. Company URLs are read from the Input tab, and companies already in the Researched tab are skipped.

### 2. Research each company
Periodix Actions returns the full LinkedIn company profile: industry, specialties, headcount, headcount growth over 6, 12, and 24 months, average tenure, HQ and all offices, founding year, followers, and website.

### 3. Score and save
Claude scores ICP fit 1 to 10 with a reason. Every company is saved to the Researched tab with icp_fit yes or no.

## Research LinkedIn companies and score ICP fit with Periodix Actions and AI

Paste LinkedIn company URLs into a Google Sheet and get back full company profiles plus an AI ICP score: industry, specialties, headcount and range, headcount growth over 6, 12, and 24 months, average employee tenure, HQ and all offices, founding year, followers, website, tagline, and description. Headcount growth comes straight from LinkedIn, so you can spot companies that are scaling before you reach out.

Research and AI-score 1,000 companies for about $12 ($10 of Periodix Actions plus about $2 of Claude Haiku), compared with a $185 Clay plan, or $495 if you call Clay from n8n, since Clay's HTTP API is only on its Growth plan. No scraper actors, no cookies, and the same output fields every run.

### How it works
1. Reads company URLs from the Input tab and skips companies already researched.
2. Periodix Actions fetches each LinkedIn company profile.
3. Key fields are flattened, including headcount growth, a strong buying signal.
4. Claude scores each company against your ICP.
5. Results land in the Researched tab with icp_score, icp_reason, and icp_fit.

### Setup
1. Install the verified Periodix Actions node (works on n8n Cloud and self-hosted), sign up at actions.periodix.net, connect a LinkedIn profile, and pick it in Get Company Profile.
2. Create a Google Sheet with two tabs: Input (column: company_url) and Researched (columns: company_url, public_identifier, name, website, industry, employee_count, employee_range, hq_city, hq_country, offices, office_count, founded, followers, headcount_growth_6m, headcount_growth_12m, headcount_growth_24m, avg_tenure, specialties, tagline, description, icp_score, icp_reason, icp_fit, researched_at).
3. Connect Google Sheets, add your Anthropic credential, and describe your ICP in ICP Config.

### Customization
Swap Claude for OpenAI or Gemini. Replace the last node with HubSpot or Notion to push qualified accounts to your CRM. Add a Periodix Actions search step before Get Company Profile to research every company from a LinkedIn or Sales Navigator company search.

### Pricing
From $10/month per connected LinkedIn profile with 1,000 results included, and every next 2,000 results for just $10. Or $49/month unlimited. Each company lookup counts as one result.

Built on the infrastructure behind Periodix (rated 4.9/5 on G2): 0 LinkedIn accounts lost across 25,000 connected profiles in the last 24 months.
